daily.brief: 過去約26小時（11日19:30至12日21:23）有235則帖、78個帳號。共同看好集中在$AMD（6個帳號）、$GOOGL（2個帳號）、$ONDS（2個帳號）同$MNTS（2個帳號）。分歧最明顯在$NVDA（7看好對7看淡）。最大變化係黃仁勳涉及與Kimberly Powell的第二段關係傳聞，盤後$NVDA跌8%，本周市值損失約6000億美元，帶動AMD受惠討論。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好主要在$AMD同$GOOGL。@wallstengine 指出William Blair將$AMD上調至Outperform，理由是Nvidia潛在的領導真空，預期AMD營收在2027年增長超過80%，數據中心AI營收將在第四季超越其伺服器CPU業務（原帖）。@EliteOptions2 分享交易計劃，關注Jensen辭職官方新聞，可能使$NVDA再跌至153，$AMD盤後升25+，目標AMD將至600（原帖）。@Frenchie_ 詳述醜聞同Bernstein將倍數與目標價從400美元下調的討論（原帖）。$GOOGL方面，@Mr_Derivatives 則指$GOOGL現在接近超越$NVDA成為世界第三大公司（原帖），@DeItaone 引HSBC「不要浪費一個好的拋售」並列出包括$GOOGL的買入股票（原帖）。

共同看淡

今日無共同看淡。bear列表為空，看淡觀點未形成多帳號共識。

分歧

$NVDA是最大分歧，7個帳號看好對7個看淡，120則提及。@Mr_Derivatives 認為玩笑話不談，終究仍需要GPU來推動這場AI革命，$NVDA最終會走出這個困境（原帖）。@aleabitoreddit 不同意，指Jensen Huang對$NVDA幾乎不可替代，就像從$TSLA拿掉Elon，估值與信心會崩潰（原帖）。@daniel_koss 分析董事會，11人移除他需要6票，認為董事會清楚知道保留黃仁勳符合Nvidia經濟利益（原帖）。$MU也有分歧，@TradexWhisperer 指出3天內從667美元升至828美元約24%（原帖），@themissinglinks 視記憶體股為線索。

其他值得留意

最多人講的是$NVDA（120提及、44帳號），其次$AMD（11提及）。$ONDS Q3業績雙重超預期，收入1.68億對比預期1.48億（@StockSavvyShay），$MNTS 則有太空機器人組裝進展的正面消息。

briefing.html:
今日簡報

過去約26小時討論集中在Nvidia領導層傳聞。共同看好$AMD（6個帳號）、$GOOGL（2個帳號）、$ONDS（2個帳號）同$MNTS（2個帳號），@wallstengine 引William Blair上調，@EliteOptions2 目標AMD至600、NVDA可能至153。$NVDA本身7對7分歧，有帳號認為GPU仍必要最終會恢復，亦有認為黃仁勳不可替代。無共同看淡。7日視角顯示$AMD、$APP等有共識，指數分歧；28日則$AMD、$SOFI最穩，$RDDT等看淡，$SPY同$CRWV仍高度分裂。

daily.brief: Over the past ~26 hours (11th 19:30 to 12th 21:23) there were 235 posts from 78 accounts. Common bullish views concentrated on $AMD (6 accounts), $GOOGL (2 accounts), $ONDS (2 accounts) and $MNTS (2 accounts). Clearest split on $NVDA (7 bull vs 7 bear). Biggest change is the rumor of Jensen Huang’s second relationship with Kimberly Powell, post-market $NVDA down 8%, weekly market cap loss around $600B, driving AMD beneficiary discussion.
daily.full:
Consensus

Common bullish mainly on $AMD and $GOOGL. @wallstengine notes William Blair upgraded $AMD to Outperform on potential Nvidia leadership vacuum, expecting AMD revenue growth over 80% in 2027 and data center AI revenue surpassing server CPU business in Q4 (post). @EliteOptions2 shares a trading plan watching for official Jensen resignation news, which could send $NVDA down to 153 again, $AMD up 25+ after hours, targeting AMD to 600 (post). @Frenchie_ details the scandal and Bernstein cutting multiple and price target from $400 (post). On $GOOGL, @Mr_Derivatives notes $GOOGL is now close to overtaking $NVDA as the world’s third-largest company (post), while @DeItaone cites HSBC saying “don’t waste a good selloff” and listing buys including $GOOGL (post).

Common Bearish

No common bearish names today. The bear list is empty; bearish views have not formed multi-account consensus.

Divergence

$NVDA is the biggest split, 7 bull accounts vs 7 bear, 120 mentions. @Mr_Derivatives says jokes aside, GPUs are still needed to drive this AI revolution and $NVDA will eventually get through this (post). @aleabitoreddit disagrees, arguing Jensen Huang is almost irreplaceable for $NVDA, like removing Elon from $TSLA would collapse valuation and confidence (post). @daniel_koss analyzes the board: 11 members need 6 votes to remove him, and the board knows keeping Huang is in Nvidia’s economic interest (post). $MU also splits, with @TradexWhisperer noting the move from $667 to $828 in 3 days, about 24% (post), and @themissinglinks treating memory as a clue.

Other Notes

Most discussed is $NVDA (120 mentions, 44 accounts), followed by $AMD (11 mentions). $ONDS Q3 double beat with revenue $168M vs $148M expected (@StockSavvyShay), while $MNTS has positive space robotics assembly progress news.
